changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'dbo' and table_name = 'RebuildJobStatus') begin create table [dbo].[RebuildJobStatus]( JobToken int not null, LastStartedOn datetime not null, LastStartedBy int, LastCompletedOn datetime null, [State] int not null, constraint [PK_RebuildJobStatus] primary key clustered ( JobToken asc ) ) end
